notes: v6.4.5 - The no-fuss update: (1) Song Finder now offers three versions of the song it finds - Original, Slow + Reverb, Sped Up - with clear Download and Import buttons. (2) Downloads, clipping and song search heal themselves: if your browser sign-in cannot be read (for example while Chrome is open), the panel tries another way instead of stopping. (3) SETUP.bat checks first and skips the sign-in step when your connection does not need it. (4) Text Animations hardened - a failed apply cleans up, and Diagnostics now names the exact property involved. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
